response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT link_to_member, SUM(amount) AS s FROM income WHERE link_to_member IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_member), sh AS (SELECT link_to_member, s, CAST(s AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(s) FROM g) AS share FROM g), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM sh) SELECT SUM(sh.s) AS total_amount, AVG(sh.share) AS avg_share_of_kept, AVG(sh.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_share_minus_avg FROM sh CROSS JOIN a WHERE sh.share > a.avg_share

assumptions.assumption: The average share in (2) and (3) is computed over the kept groups (those with share strictly above the average across all groups); (3) subtracts the all-group average share from each kept share.
Empty-string link_to_member values are treated as present; only NULLs are dropped.

alternatives.interpretation: Report (2) as the average share across all groups (the threshold average), not just the kept groups.
